Hand-embroidered in Multan by 300 women artisans

Bridal and formal wear, everyday outfits, handmade shoes and bags. Every embroidered piece carries the stitching of rural women artisans, from Tarkashi to Mukesh work.

Thirty artisans in 2004. More than three hundred today.

Aadiz began to give women in remote areas a market for their embroidery. Twenty years on, the mission is the same: take their crafts to the international market, and grow the community to 2,000 artisans.

Tarkashi, Mukesh and the crafts of the sub-continent

Our artisans work in Tarkashi, Mukesh (Kamdani), Gota work, Balochi and Afghani embroidery and more. Our block and digital printing teams help us reshape textile with hand embroidery concepts in a modern look.
